segments.sn44.6:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto, āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
segments.sn44.6:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākoṭṭhiko tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākoṭṭhikena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn44.6:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākoṭṭhikaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn44.6:1.4: “‘kiṃ nu kho, āvuso koṭṭhika, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti … pe …‘kiṃ panāvuso, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.sn44.6:1.6: ‘etampi kho, āvuso, abyākataṃ bhagavatā – neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vadesi”.
segments.sn44.6:1.8: “Ko nu kho, āvuso, hetu, ko paccayo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.6:2.1: “Rūpārāmassa kho, āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti;
segments.sn44.6:2.2: ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti;
segments.sn44.6:2.3: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti;
segments.sn44.6:2.4: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti.
segments.sn44.6:2.5: Vedanārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti … pe … saññārāmassa kho, āvuso … pe … saṅkhārārāmassa kho āvuso … pe … viññāṇārāmassa kho, āvuso, viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti”.
segments.sn44.6:3.1: “Na rūpārāmassa kho, āvuso, na rūparatassa na rūpasammuditassa, rūpanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti.
segments.sn44.6:3.3: Na vedanārāmassa kho, āvuso … pe … na saññārāmassa kho, āvuso … pe … na saṅkhārārāmassa kho, āvuso … pe … na viññāṇārāmassa kho, āvuso, na viññāṇaratassa na viññāṇasammuditassa, viññāṇanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti … pe … ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti.
segments.sn44.6:3.8: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn44.6:4.1: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.6:4.3: Bhavārāmassa kho, āvuso, bhavaratassa bhavasammuditassa, bhavanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti.
segments.sn44.6:4.5: Na bhavārāmassa kho, āvuso, na bhavaratassa na bhavasammuditassa, bhavanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti.
segments.sn44.6:4.7: Ayampi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn44.6:5.1: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.6:5.3: Upādānārāmassa kho, āvuso, upādānaratassa upādānasammuditassa, upādānanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti.
segments.sn44.6:5.5: Na upādānārāmassa kho, āvuso, na upādānaratassa na upādānasammuditassa, upādānanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti … pe …‘neva, hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti.
segments.sn44.6:5.7: Ayampi kho āvuso, pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn44.6:6.1: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.6:6.3: Taṇhārāmassa kho, āvuso, taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti … pe …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa hoti.
segments.sn44.6:6.5: Na taṇhārāmassa kho, āvuso, na taṇhāratassa na taṇhāsammuditassa, taṇhānirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti … pe.
segments.sn44.6:6.6: …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ tipissa na hoti.
segments.sn44.6:6.7: Ayampi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn44.6:7.1: “Siyā panāvuso, aññopi pariyāyo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.6:7.2: “Ettha dāni, āvuso sāriputta, ito uttari kiṃ icchasi?
segments.sn44.6:7.3: Taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttassa, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhuno vaṭṭaṃ [vattaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.) vaddhaṃ (pī.)] natthi paññāpanāyā”ti.
